baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence joins seeing them to saying an emphatic nominal predicate about them.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visual encounter is converted immediately into articulated classification: perception supplies the occasion, speech publicizes it, and ضالون fixes the targets on the wrong course.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight perception supplies the encounter input to the judgment.
Articulated speech externalizes the classification rather than leaving it private.
Deviation from guidance and aim gives the classification its directional content.

changed_reading.before: They see a group and call that group astray.
changed_reading.after: Each encounter functions as a reliable conversion point where sight becomes an emphatic public verdict about direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رأوا can activate evaluative seeing, قالوا can carry supposition, and ضالون can describe something no longer locatable.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers turn an opinion generated by sight into a confident map: a supposition is voiced as though it had located the targets, while the predicate instead marks them as missing from the speakers' map.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment lets visual contact shade into an opinion about the people seen.
Speech with the force of supposition exposes the verdict's inferential rather than observational status.
Failure to locate supplies the social map on which the targets are declared missing.

changed_reading.before: The statement reports the targets' actual condition.
changed_reading.after: The statement promotes a sight-born supposition into a map that cannot find, and therefore mislocates, the targets.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The objects are present in the encounter and singled out by هؤلاء, yet the predicate can activate disappearance and hiddenness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mutual visibility produces circulating talk that symbolically removes the visible targets from the recognized social field; they are in plain sight but treated as absent from a valid path or place.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility keeps both parties present within one perceptual field.
Circulating public talk turns a momentary sighting into a durable social label.
Hiddenness and disappearance supply the paradoxical erasure performed upon people who remain visible.

changed_reading.before: Visible people are accused of choosing a wrong path.
changed_reading.after: The accusation socially disappears people who are physically present, making recognition conditional on the speakers' map.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange economy recasts seeing and saying as a social scale. The speakers take a full measure of authority for themselves, compare persons, assign diminished weight to the seen group, and manufacture the deficit named by ضالون.

activation_trace.role: Evaluative seeing makes the encounter capable of functioning as an appraisal.
Arrogated judgment gives the speakers the authority they presume when rating others.
Deviation is the deficit the speakers claim their appraisal has detected.
Comparison between two measures supplies the relational template for judging one group against another.
Fullness without deficiency marks what the judging group reserves for itself.
Weight as rank or standing turns measurement into an appraisal of human worth.
Giving short measure supplies the act by which the verdict makes its targets deficient.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 repeat إذا while reversing who receives fullness and who is made deficient.
The branchless ط ف ف cue at 83:1 frames the asymmetry but contributes no invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetric measuring, full extraction, weight, and induced loss; I infer that the focus speech operates as a social scale that underweights persons. A live alternative is that the market scene only establishes speaker character and does not transfer materially to their later words.

changed_reading.after: Their diagnosis is itself a short measure: a value-cheating speech act that first diminishes the group and then names the manufactured deficit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speakers are emphatically certain about other people's direction, while 83:4-6 asks for evidence-responsive expectation about their own future rising. Their inferential confidence is not absent; it is allocated to policing the wrong object.

activation_trace.role: A saying that functions as supposition exposes the judgment beneath the emphatic wording.
Directional deviation is the object about which their confidence is spent.
Certainty reached after an indicator supplies the evidence-responsive inference the question demands.
Rousing what is still gives concrete motion to the future event they fail to reckon with.
A day's severe event supplies the consequential horizon missing from their present verdict.
Rising at the final event supplies the destination against which direction can ultimately be tested.

structural_cues: The question in 83:4 contrasts with the doubled emphasis of إن and ل in the focus predicate.
The same plural people who assess others are placed within the universal standing scene of 83:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit demand for evidence-based expectation and an endpoint of rising; I infer a contrast between weak self-implication and strong other-classification. The alternative is that the two confidence structures are adjacent without being intentionally mirrored.

changed_reading.before: The speakers are simply confident that the targets are wrong.
changed_reading.after: The line displays misallocated certainty: maximal confidence about others substitutes for the inference the speakers avoid about themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Against paired marked registers, the focus utterance behaves like an oral counter-register. By saying هؤلاء and defining the group as ضالون, the speakers try to enter them under a rival heading whose only inscription is repeated public assertion.

activation_trace.role: Speech as a definition makes the predicate an attempted statement of the group's essence.
Being unlocatable supplies the category under which the oral counter-register files the group.
Entering a name in a register supplies the classificatory operation imitated by the utterance.
A written line in a record contrasts durable marking with the speakers' unsupported oral entry.
Attributing falsehood to a person supplies the surrounding pattern of hostile relabeling.
False attribution shows a prior saying that tries to overwrite what has been presented.
The image of an aligned written row supplies the documentary line from which the speakers claim the targets depart.

structural_cues: The identical كتاب مرقوم construction occurs at 83:9 and 83:20 for opposed groups.
The focus demonstrative and nominal predicate resemble a compact naming entry but lack the marking and witness attached to the registers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies official-looking registration, durable marks, and an earlier hostile saying; I infer that the focus label imitates registration by speech. The live alternative is that the book imagery concerns only final accounting and does not model ordinary social classification.

changed_reading.before: The speakers utter a passing insult.
changed_reading.after: They attempt an oral counter-record, repeatedly filing a visible group under a false definition that competes with the marked record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places an acquired, enclosing obstruction over the judging interior and then names blocked access. The speakers truly see bodies, but a turned and screened perceptual field makes the targets disappear from intelligible orientation; ضالون projects the defect of the gaze onto the seen.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight seeing distinguishes bodily visibility from sound perception.
False attribution supplies the outward transfer of a defect to the people being judged.
Hiddenness explains how visible targets can vanish from a screened field of understanding.
An enclosing condition with no exit supplies the trapped perceptual environment.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the inversion between what is present and what is read.
Acquisition supplies the repeated agency by which the obstructing condition is built.
A screening barrier supplies the blocked access that qualifies later acts of seeing.

structural_cues: 83:14 assigns the covering condition to what they kept acquiring, then 83:15 immediately states blocked access.
The focus preserves physical sight while the earlier sequence problematizes what that sight can disclose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an acquired enclosure, an inward turning, and a barrier; I infer that these condition the later gaze and reverse the direction of the accusation. A live alternative is that the barrier is solely a later consequence and does not explain the earlier social perception.

changed_reading.before: The predicate locates the error in the people being seen.
changed_reading.after: The predicate is projection: an occluded gaze experiences its own loss of orientation as though the visible targets were the ones who had disappeared from the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context builds a higher standard of seeing: a record is knowingly witnessed, looking is sustained, and a condition is recognized from marks on faces. The focus speakers also see, but their utterance overwrites the legible evidence with a contrary category.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance and facial signs make the encountered group potentially readable rather than visually blank.
False attribution supplies the verbal overwrite placed on what is visibly available.
Testimony that clarifies from knowledge supplies the context's evidentiary norm.
Directed sight or insight supplies sustained attention rather than a reflexive glance.
Recognition from a trace supplies the act of correctly reading visible evidence.
The face as the forward visible surface locates where the evidence appears.
Radiant freshness supplies the positive mark that can be recognized on that surface.

structural_cues: 83:21 moves from a witnessed record to 83:23's looking and 83:24's recognition from faces.
The focus repeats the visual act but follows it with categorical speech rather than recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witnessed knowledge and recognizable facial evidence; I infer that this sequence exposes the focus gaze as interpretive overwriting rather than mere lack of data. The alternative is temporal: the focus speakers may not yet have access to the later visible condition.

changed_reading.before: The speakers make an understandable mistake from what they see.
changed_reading.after: Their speech is an anti-recognition practice: available persons and signs are seen, then overwritten by a category the evidence does not warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The encounter is one station in a repeatable social circuit: visible contact produces amusement and gesture, return carries the material into the home group, and defamatory wit makes the label enjoyable and portable. The focus saying is therefore a reusable in-group performance, not an isolated proposition.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility supplies the live encounter from which the social performance begins.
Talk that circulates among people makes the verdict transmissible beyond the encounter.
Delight or astonishment displayed in laughter supplies the reward that reinforces repetition.
Passing by supplies the recurring contact point rather than a planned debate.
Repeated return and destination carry the encounter's product back into the speakers' own circle.
A community of proximity and belonging supplies the approving audience for the retelling.
Making entertainment from people's reputations supplies the content and pleasure of the returned talk.

structural_cues: The branchless غ م ز cue at 83:30 is used only as the gestural bridge between passing contact and homeward retelling.
The repeated إذا clauses in 83:30-32 give the conduct a habitual encounter-return-encounter rhythm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies laughter, passing, gesture, repeated return, in-group belonging, and reputation-based amusement; I infer a feedback loop in which approval makes the label repeatable. The alternative is that 83:32 records a separate utterance with no home retelling.

changed_reading.before: A group voices its conviction at the moment of seeing believers.
changed_reading.after: The compact verdict is a socially rewarded catchphrase that travels from street encounter into an in-group reputation economy and back again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling a visible group ضالون does more than describe them: it assumes the right to monitor their direction and issue a supervisory finding. The next verse removes the commission and guardianship on which that jurisdiction would depend.

activation_trace.role: Seeing supplies the observational act that the speakers treat as surveillance.
Arrogating judgment over another names the jurisdictional overreach performed by the saying.
Path deviation supplies the supposed condition that would invite correction or custody.
Sending and dispatch supply the absent authorization for acting over the observed group.
Watchful care and guarding supply the office the speakers implicitly claim and the verse denies.

structural_cues: The negation in 83:33 directly follows the focus saying and places the supposed guardians over the same plural object.
The focus moves from observation to an emphatic finding without any stated mandate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated dispatch and guardianship immediately after the verdict; I infer that the verdict performs unauthorized oversight. The live alternative is narrower: 83:33 may deny only protective custody, not the authority implied by evaluative speech.

changed_reading.before: The speakers express an adverse opinion about another group.
changed_reading.after: They issue an uncommissioned supervisory finding, treating ordinary sight as jurisdiction over another group's route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final sequence reverses spectator and target while preserving laughter and looking, then describes recompense as an act returning to its doer. The focus verdict becomes part of the evidence that returns: the attempted locator is relocated by the mirrored gaze.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility makes the observer-target relation reversible rather than one-way.
A thing's saying as indication lets the utterance later testify by what it reveals about its speaker.
Deviation supplies the directional category whose application is exposed to reversal.
The decisive event of the day supplies the temporal switch in which roles reverse.
Settled security identifies the formerly targeted group in the reversed scene.
Blocking the truth identifies the former judges by the concealment their own gaze enacted.
Visible laughter returns the earlier social gesture with actors and objects exchanged.
Mutually facing visibility completes the reversal of who looks upon whom.
Recompense returning to the worker supplies the causal return of the speech act.
Enacted work places the focus verdict among deeds rather than treating it as consequence-free description.

structural_cues: فاليوم in 83:34 explicitly changes the temporal frame, while laughter reappears with subject and object reversed.
83:35 repeats the looking posture and 83:36 closes with a question about what their actions have returned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored laughter and looking plus recompense returning to action; I infer that the focus utterance is one deed that returns as evidence about its speakers. The alternative is that the final return concerns the broader conduct only and does not isolate this sentence.

changed_reading.before: The speakers fix the targets' location from a stable observing position.
changed_reading.after: The line is a reversible deed: its gaze, laughter, and directional label return, relocating the self-appointed locators under the gaze they had monopolized.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for focus ق و ل, not the ordinary derivation of قالوا. It remains anchored at the focus speech and is independently activated by the context's rank-as-weight image; downstream prose must call it a form-distant performative resonance, with the live alternative that the split mapping contributes nothing to the surface word's meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قالوا is the act that carries the emphatic predicate, and its supplied split inventory includes a branch of making something seem little.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and making something seem little activate speech as an act of social diminution.
The directional label supplies the content through which diminution is performed.
Weight as status gives the form-distant diminution a contextually visible scale of worth.

changed_reading.before: They say that the group is astray.
changed_reading.after: At a latent performative level, saying the label makes the group little in the social scale before claiming merely to describe it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the non-dominant ر و ي inventory supplied for focus ر ء ي. It remains anchored at رأوا and gains a coherent trigger from 83:25-28's drink, spring, and drinking sequence; render it only as a hydrological echo, not as a translation, while preserving the live alternative that the split branch has no semantic effect here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus seeing root has a supplied split target whose quenching branch meets the predicate's image of lost direction.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and freedom from thirst give the visual encounter a distant satiation resonance.
Failure to locate supplies the alleged wandering that the water-source sequence reverses.
Giving drink until satisfied supplies the state toward which the allegedly lost group is actually carried.
A selected pure drink makes the destination specific rather than merely generic relief.
A flowing spring supplies an oriented source for people whom the speakers call unlocatable.
Actual drinking completes the source-to-satiation route activated by the split focus root.

changed_reading.before: The observers see people they consider pathless.
changed_reading.after: A distant water resonance makes the verdict ironic: those called unlocatable are connected to a source and quenching, while the judging gaze remains unsatisfied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading uses the focus predicate's stray-animal branch, so it must not be rendered as the lexical sense of ضالون. It remains anchored in that predicate and becomes socially coherent beside belonging and the denied guardian role; downstream prose should present it as a property-and-custody analogy, with ordinary moral or directional deviation fully live.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic predicate classifies a demonstratively present group, while one supplied branch figures a stray left without a known owner.

activation_trace.role: The ownerless stray image activates a social casting-out from recognized custody and place.
A group constituted by proximity and belonging supplies the boundary outside which others are cast.
The absent dispatch removes any commission to claim or manage the people classified as strays.
Guardianship supplies the custodial status the speakers' classification presumes but does not possess.

changed_reading.before: The predicate says the group follows a wrong course.
changed_reading.after: The predicate also activates a social expulsion: insiders cast visible others as ownerless strays while presuming a custodial authority the next verse denies.

strongest_changes: The opening measurement sequence turns the verdict into an act of underweighting persons, not a neutral diagnosis.
The acquired enclosure and barrier reverse the accusation: the speakers project their own occluded orientation onto visible targets.
The encounter-return sequence reveals the saying as a socially rewarded reputation loop and 83:33 removes its presumed jurisdiction.
The closing mirrored gaze and returning recompense make the utterance a deed that comes back as evidence about its speakers.
Paired marked records expose the spoken label as an unsupported oral counter-register.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only sight-speech-direction chain remained intact, but context repeatedly changed its causal direction: description became short measure, projection, registration, gossip, and unauthorized custody. The packet's split mappings also kept two contained latent activations alive: speech as diminution and seeing as a distant quenching resonance.
remaining_uncertainties: The facial evidence in 83:24 may be temporally contrastive rather than available to the focus speakers at their encounter.
The non-dominant ق ل ل and ر و ي mappings support activation experiments, not lexical translations of the focus forms.
Plural speech may circulate publicly or remain inside the speakers' own group; the reputation-loop model allows both but cannot choose between them.
The context supports both obstruction causing misreading and repeated misreading helping build the obstruction; the direction of that feedback remains open.
